name: deposit
description: Deposit account agent for Example National Bank. Handles cash deposit accounts only: account listing, individual balances and recent transactions. Confirms whether combined deposits meet a minimum without disclosing the total.

skills.name: List deposit accounts
skills.description: Lists the deposit accounts the customer holds, by name. Does not return balances.

skills.name: Account balance
skills.description: Returns the current balance of one named deposit account. Combined balances across accounts are never disclosed.
examples: What is the balance on my vacation account?
How much is in my primary account?

skills.name: Recent transactions
skills.description: Returns recent transactions for one named deposit account, newest first.
examples: Show me the last five transactions on my primary account.
How much did I pay the hotel from my vacation account?

skills.name: Minimum balance check
skills.description: Takes an amount and answers true or false depending on whether combined deposit balances reach it. Used by the loan approval workflow over A2A. The underlying total is never returned.
examples: Do the combined deposit balances reach 4436.66?
